scope.summary: Build the professional native Tailor interlink pane for verified PoseKit evidence, character-sheet mapping, lift/camera/contact proposals, manual correction, and explicit apply/recovery.
acceptance_criteria: Tailor opens PaneType::AtelierEditor through the shared typed pane-navigation route and selects AtelierPanelTab::Posekit or AtelierPanelTab::CastkitCodex through the typed panel API; atelier-tab-posekit, atelier-content-posekit, atelier-tab-ckc, atelier-content-ckc, atelier-ckc-character-ref, atelier-ckc-sheet-version-ref, and atelier-ckc-sheet-artifact-list are inspection targets only, never the navigation API or Tailor ownership.

Provides stable native ids tailor-interlink-pane, tailor-interlink-binding-source, tailor-interlink-receipt-validity, tailor-interlink-lift-state, tailor-interlink-joint-confidence, tailor-interlink-camera-candidates, tailor-interlink-reprojection-error, tailor-interlink-contact-state, tailor-interlink-proposal-diff, tailor-interlink-stale-conflict, tailor-interlink-job-status, tailor-interlink-cancel, and tailor-interlink-retry.

Manual correction supports accept/reject/remap joint, camera-candidate selection, 3D handle correction, immutable amended proposal, compare, and revert before explicit selected apply through typed backend commands.

Blank, loading, partial, tampered, offline, merge-incompatible, stale/conflicted, cancelled, failed, and retry states remain distinguishable; Jobs, Problems, and History expose attribution, progress, diagnostics, recovery, and receipts without stealing focus.

Argus/AccessKit proves docked, floating, narrow, 4K, and DPI layouts; keyboard/focus order, non-color state, readable text, no overlap/clipping, cancellation, retry, and no-focus-steal behavior are required.

Stable actions include tailor-interlink-open-posekit, tailor-interlink-open-ckc, tailor-interlink-joint-{joint_id}-accept, tailor-interlink-joint-{joint_id}-reject, tailor-interlink-joint-{joint_id}-remap, tailor-interlink-camera-{candidate_id}-select, tailor-interlink-contact-{contact_id}, tailor-interlink-correct-3d, tailor-interlink-compare-{proposal_revision}, tailor-interlink-revert-{proposal_revision}, and tailor-interlink-selected-apply; template substitutions are canonical escaped typed ids.

Every repeated inspectable record has a stable escaped typed-id row identity: tailor-interlink-joint-{joint_id}-row, tailor-interlink-camera-{candidate_id}-row, tailor-interlink-contact-{contact_id}-row, and tailor-interlink-proposal-{proposal_revision}-row; selection and action ids resolve to the same typed record without relying on row position.
scope.risk_if_missed: A shallow or ambiguous pane would cause operators and models to confuse 2D evidence with applied 3D authority or miss stale/tampered source state.

surfaces: Tailor Jobs, Problems, and History projections

target_entries: Tailor > Interlink > PoseKit and character sheets
Tailor > Interlink > Correct, compare, apply, and recover
Tailor model manual > Interlink author_ids and typed commands

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: The implementing MT emits or projects its applicable Tailor lifecycle, command, job, validation, or authority event through the shared Flight Recorder contract; pure solver kernels surface typed receipts through their owning run.
The shared internal_diagnostics substrate is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; use its open projection contract and do not fork a Tailor-only diagnostics runtime.
The shared Palmistry watcher is supplied by WP-KERNEL-012/WP-KERNEL-016; long-running Tailor jobs inherit bounded child-stall and survivor coverage during the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
